listed_quote.quote: Upon effectiveness of the merger contemplated by the Merger Agreement, USG&E, MVC’s largest portfolio company, will merge with the Merger Sub and become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Equus, a publicly-traded company.

announcement.quote: On April 24, 2017, MVC Capital, Inc. (“MVC”) and certain other shareholders of U.S. Gas & Electric, Inc. (“USG&E”) entered into a Stock Purchase and Plan of Merger (“Merger Agreement”) with Equus Total Return, Inc. (“Equus”) and ETR Merger Sub., Inc. (“Merger Sub”), a newly-formed wholly-owned subsidiary of Equus.

deals.notes: MVC Capital is a seller (33% holder of Equus and owner of USG&E), not a party absorbed. USG&E is an operating company held by MVC as a portfolio company, so the pair is not two listed funds. Outcome of the Equus/USG&E deal is not stated in the excerpts; outcome set by the both_listed rule.

problems: MVC Capital's own later filings (tender offers, buybacks, proxy) are not about a fund merger as far as the excerpts show.
